title: MISC EQUIPMENT - the grenades prose of the equipment descriptions
audit_comment: OA round thirty-four (capture p. 98): the miscellaneous equipment descriptions - the grenades prose (pepper, dust, flash powder and poison smoke)

banner.title: MISCELLANEOUS EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTIONS (THE GRENADES PROSE), printed capture p. 98 - the OA misc equipment round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the page - the grenades prose cross-checked paragraph-by-paragraph between the two passes; every printed number agrees - zero contested cells. The lone glyph artifact is the em-dash class (the print hyphen against the compressed em-dash in the not-modern-sense clause - not a pin, noted). The grenades are blown-out eggshells (nutshells and paper packets also used) filled with powders - four kinds pin: pepper-filled (single target, save versus poison or incapacitated 1-6 rounds by choking and sneezing), dust-filled (the same save, blinded 1-6 rounds), flash powder (thrown onto a fire source, all looking automatically blinded 1-3 rounds, the may-or-may-not-looking allowed a save versus petrification) and poison smoke (cast onto a fire source, fills five feet by five feet per round, save versus poison or blinded and incapacitated, 1-2 hit points per round within, enough powder for a 10-foot by 10-foot area, remains one turn or until the wind). The to-hit doctrine pins as a bool pair: no armor modifiers (the contents burst in a small cloud on impact) and the eggshell fragility (a fall of 10 feet or more with damage forces a save versus crushing blow per grenade carried). The barding prose box and the armor descriptions box stay open
